sam_k: Kicking off a config-only deploy to tweak routing + batching + limits for redwood-generic-2. change window tonight 22:15-22:45 UTC. canary 5% -> please ack. @miranda @raj_s

deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED: change-id cfg-2026-1847, target=models/redwood-generic-2/config, mode=canary(5%), initiated by sam_k

eva: quick q — are we pinning the model variant? last time fallback to v1 caused slow tails.

sam_k: yes pinning to v2.2-quant. config snippet below.

sam_k: ```json
{
  "routing_policy": "cost-aware",
  "pin_version": "v2.2-quant",
  "batching": {
    "max_tokens_per_batch": 512,
    "max_batch_size": 32,
    "idle_timeout_ms": 8
  },
  "timeouts": {
    "inference_timeout_ms": 12000,
    "rpc_timeout_ms": 15000
  },
  "limits": {
    "concurrent_requests_per_instance": 24,
    "qps": 200
  },
  "slo": {
    "max_p90_latency_ms": 320,
    "error_rate_threshold_pct": 1.0,
    "auto_rollback": true
  },
  "canary": {
    "traffic_percent": 5,
    "duration_minutes": 30
  }
}
```

miranda: looks good. prefer aggressive auto-rollback — p95>400ms or errors>1% should trigger immediate rollback + page.

sam_k: good call. I'll add p95 400ms rule to the alerting and make sure paging is wired.

deploy-bot: CANARY HEALTH: metrics stream connected. initial window p50=80ms p95=210ms errors=0.2%

raj_s: heads-up — batch jobs typically spike around 23:05 UTC. canary colliding with that will skew results. can we start earlier?

sam_k: yup. moving start to 22:15 UTC so canary completes before the batch spike. updating change window.

deploy-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: canary start 1771206900 (22:15 UTC), change-id cfg-2026-1847, commits: routing/batching/timeouts/limits

oncall-bot: @oncall escalation set: cfg-2026-1847 -> infra-night. pager triggers on error_rate>1% OR p95>400ms sustained 5m.

eva: perf lgtm from my side. +1 :thumbsup:

miranda: +1

sam_k: launching canary now.

deploy-bot: CANARY COMPLETED: healthy. canary held at 5% for 30m with no regressions. no rollback triggered. scheduled promotion to 50% in 30m if metrics stable.

raj_s: thanks — watch downstream cache hit rate, batching tweak might nudge misses.

sam_k: noted, will watch traces and cache metrics in the next 45m. follow-ups in #eng-runtime if anything odd. thanks everyone. :shipit:
